annotation.title_clean: DRAFT Compromise Amendments on the Draft Report: Proposal for a regulation on harmonised rules on Artificial Intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act)
annotation.title_en: DRAFT Compromise Amendments on the Draft Report: Proposal for a regulation on harmonised rules on Artificial Intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament IMCO and LIBE Committees (Rapporteurs Benifei & Tudorache)
annotation.summary_en: European Parliament IMCO/LIBE consolidated draft compromise amendments (May 2023) to the Commission's proposed Artificial Intelligence Act. Covers notified bodies and conformity assessment, recitals, delegated powers, environmental impact and AI literacy within a risk-based horizontal AI regime, with no robot-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Member States designate notifying authorities with independence and impartiality safeguards for conformity assessment bodies
Notified bodies must be independent, competent and meet minimum cybersecurity requirements
Providers and deployers must ensure sufficient AI literacy of staff
Commission to review prohibited practices and high-risk list annually with the AI Office
Commission to develop methodology measuring AI environmental impact
